summary.text: Paul Spencer is the Republican candidate for the New Mexico House of Representatives, District 6, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026, and Ballotpedia's campaign finance records list a 2024 run for the same district that he lost in the general election.
